title: FXVCS asset index, format version 1 (canonical JSON)
description: Derived from a pinned Git tree: every FXVCS-managed entry with its normalized path, Git mode, and the SHA-256 of the exact pointer bytes, sorted by path in byte order with no duplicates. Its canonical-JSON digest is the component assetRoot recorded in a Release.

entries.description: Sorted by path (byte order), strictly increasing; verified semantically.
